en: The Big Bad Fox and Other Tales...
orig: Le Grand Méchant Renard et autres contes...
plotEn: The film begins in a theater with a group of animals preparing a show. The Fox, the host of the show, tells the audience they will share three different stories, most of which take place on a French farm led by animals. After speaking with the audience, the play begins when the animals tell Fox they're ready.
